name: Booking Space
shortDescription: UK shared-resource booking software for rooms, desks, equipment and other church-office or venue resources.
suitableContexts: Church offices managing internal meeting rooms, desks or shared equipment
Churches or charities needing straightforward resource booking rather than a public-hire venue-management suite

pricing.summary: Booking Space advertises a 15-day trial and a 50p-per-monthly-active-user charge plus a £5 account charge. Confirm whether the current tariff meets the church's mix of internal and public users.

startingPrice.qualifier: per monthly active user, plus a £5 account charge

tiers.label: Monthly active-user pricing
tiers.detail: The supplier says charges apply only to monthly active users

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier advertises a 15-day free trial.

dataHosting: The supplier's terms say the service is hosted in the United Kingdom and/or EU from time to time.
gdprInformation: Booking Space publishes privacy and service terms. Its terms refer to UK/EU hosting and data-protection legislation; churches should assess the current processor terms, retention and role controls for their own use.
coreFeatures: Desk booking with interactive floor plans
importExport: The supplier's Digital Marketplace listing describes CSV data extraction at the end of contract
support: Digital Marketplace listing describes UK-hours phone and web-chat support

uk-operator.value: The supplier's terms identify Booking Space Limited, company number 15695980, as the England-and-Wales operator.

pricing.value: The supplier homepage advertises a 15-day trial and 50p-per-monthly-active-user pricing plus a £5 account charge.

charity-relevance.value: The UK government's Digital Marketplace entry describes shared-resource use by a company, school or charity.

editorial.assessment: Booking Space is a general UK resource-booking product rather than church-specific software. It may suit a church office or charity team managing internal rooms and shared equipment, but its public material does not present a full community-hall hire, invoicing and safeguarding workflow.
bestFor: Church offices sharing rooms, desks or equipment among staff and volunteers
Church charities seeking a lightweight, per-active-user booking system
strengths: Published low-cost active-user pricing and trial
UK operator and public legal terms
Integrations for common workplace identity systems
limitations: Not presented as church-specific or public venue-hire software
Churches hiring rooms externally should test invoices, public bookings, payments and access rules
Review current data-processing terms before adding volunteer or hirer records

procurementVerdict.problem: Conflicts over internal rooms, desks and shared equipment
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Simple active-user pricing for general shared resources
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Test a real room, equipment and volunteer-access workflow, including any public-hire boundary
